### Peace When Home Feels Chaotic
Author: Amber Ginter
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/peace-when-home-feels-chaotic.html
Passage: John 14:27
Points:
- Followers of Christ are not immune to chaotic, noisy, or stressful household situations.
- The peace Jesus offers is rooted in His unchanging character rather than favorable circumstances.
- True biblical peace is not merely the absence of trouble, but the presence of Christ within it.
- Carving out small moments of intentional quiet helps believers bring their specific anxieties to Jesus.
- Surrendering our need for control allows God to settle our internal world even when outer turmoil persists.

### Peace from Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/peace-from-jesus
Passage: John 14:27-28
Points:
- Jesus comforted His fearful disciples prior to His departure by bestowing His unique peace upon them.
- In scripture, peace denotes comprehensive spiritual wholeness and reconciliation with the Father through faith in Christ.
- Unlike worldly security, Christ's peace provides enduring confidence that difficulties cannot ultimately crush believers.
- Jesus described the Father as greater in reference to the Son's earthly humiliation compared to heavenly glory.
- Resting in the peace Christ secured grants believers assurance of His presence and loving care in every trial.
